programme.desc: The competition continues with competitors pushing their bodies to the limit by battling opponents in unforgiving head-to-head challenges, designed by host and executive producer Dwayne Johnson. They will compete on obstacles such as Launch Pad, Over the Edge, Nuts and Bolts and Lunar Impact. Winners will move on to face reigning Titan’s on Mt. programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.414: The Real Chitter / The Slimy Suspect
programme.desc: Chitter loses her memory when she bumps her head, and join the Deer Squad in being good! // Can Rammy catch the shadowy culprit behind the purple slime geyser mystery on Sparkle Island?

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S2 Ep.217: Spring is Here!
programme.desc: It's getting warmer outside, and the flowers are blooming - that must mean that spring is here! We play an outdoors game of Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do on the first day of spring.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.101: Shooting Star / Ball / Balloon
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid. // Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom. // Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.407: The Crew Builds a Giant Checkerboard / The Crew Builds a Corn Silo
programme.desc: Coach Karima is throwing Checkers Day for all the Builder Cove kids! But when everyone can't play together, Rubble & Crew save the day with construction. / Rubble and Wheeler team up to construct a solution for a mysterious mess on Farmer Zoe's farm.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.120: Cecilia and the Magic Rubies / Under the Pirate Moon
programme.desc: Santi and crew go underwater to stop Escarlata la Pirata before she steals all the Magic Rubies from Giant Clam Reef! // It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.301: Ratoncito Perez / The Berry Hungry Caterpillar
programme.desc: Dora helps Ratoncito Perez fix his magic toothbrush wand so she can get a gift for her missing tooth. // Dora meets Carlos, a giant caterpillar who wants to be a butterfly! They need to find some butterberries that will help him transform.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S3 Ep.320: Blue and Little Rainbow Riding Hood
programme.desc: Rainbow Puppy's opening up a brand-new Neighborhood Theater and everyone's pitching in to help. But who has the singing and dancing talents to play the part of The Big, Bad Wolf ?" We'll play Blue's Clues to figure it out!

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S2 Ep.209: New Rules / Lemonade
programme.desc: After damaging a patch of grass, Daisy and Mr. Crocodile go overboard trying to prevent another mishap. // When Mr. Crocodile and Daisy set up a lemonade stand, Winston competes with his blueberry-ade.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.121: Greedyguts / Where is Bali?
programme.desc: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.122: Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.207: Don't Go Grandma / Stuck / Rocket Track
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy & Tia try to stop Grandma from leaving, so they can spend more time with her / When Terri & Tommy get locked in the Garden Dome, they must put their differences aside to try to escape / Tim tries to help Tia face the new Rocket track ride.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.208: Walky Talky / Brothers / Blob Monster
programme.desc: Tim tries to return a lost walky talky to it's owner. // Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip, but soon disagree on what to do first. // When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.209: Times Machine / Super Tim / Uncle Tiberius
programme.desc: Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid telling Dad the truth. // Tim goes to DinoStar's training academy, but is confused by his hero's training methods. // Uncle Tiberius comes to visit the Rexes, and Tim must be on his best behaviour.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.404: The Crew Builds A Conveyor Belt Restaurant / The Crew Builds A Community Soup
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew want to help open a new restaurant for everyone at the Buddy Walk Race... but they can't decide what kind of restaurant to build! // When Grandpa Gravel is feeling under the weather, Rubble & Crew step in to make his signature soup.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.406: The Crew Fixes The Observatory / The Crew Builds A Meow Yard
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew are ready to replace the broken telescope lens at the Observatory. Until it starts a fiery fiasco during delivery! / Café Carl's kittens cause construction chaos in the Bark Yard! Can the crew create a conclusion to the cat catastrophe?

programme.title: PAW Patrol S14 Ep.1401: Pups Stop the Garboni
programme.desc: Farmer Al's new machine, the "Garboni" goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1313: Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin
programme.desc: Mischievous squirrels have made a plan take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.413: Cake-Astrophe / Solar Storm Scramble
programme.desc: Bobbi's birthday cakes baked by Sir Steel and Blip are a recipe for disaster when they come alive! // After feeling left out on a mission, Bobbi ends up saving the day when asteroids strike.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.503: Giant Snowball Adventure / Missing Medals
programme.desc: Dora and Boots save their friends' snowy art before giant snowballs ruin them! // Dora and Boots rescue missing medals before Swiper can get to them, saving Sports Day!

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.103: To The Lighthouse / The Golden Giant
programme.desc: When a storm blows out the lighthouse light, Santi and crew hurry to guide Mami and Abuelo back from sea. // When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.201: Explorer / Happy Parky / Storm
programme.desc: Tim explores Rumbleton to find somewhere he can have fun alone. // Tim and Kai try to give Parky the best day ever. // When a storm keeps the Rexes at home they must think of a game to pass the time.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.101: Shooting Star
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S2 Ep.214: What I Like About Blue
programme.desc: It's LOVE DAY! Josh and Blue LOVE Love Day, and Blue is making YOU something very special. While we play Blue's Clues to figure out what she's making, we help Slippery finish his Love Day Cards and help cheer up our sad Heart Friends.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.213: Watch Out For Barbabright / If I Were A Billionaire
programme.desc: The twins visit Barbabright's room. // If I were a billionaire, what would I do to achieve my dreams?

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.211: Private Club / Green Algae
programme.desc: Barbabeau, Barbabelle, and Barbabright have built a treehouse. // Barbamama is determined to stop a foul pollution.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.212: The Invasion / Prank Day
programme.desc: Barbalala receives a package and discovers little pink animals inside, which she calls the SQUEAKIES. // Barbabravo, Barbalala and Barbabeau are fed up with their brothers and sisters laughing at their expense.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.104: Tooth On The Loose / Scaredy Croc
programme.desc: When Mr. Crocodile loses a tooth, Daisy wants to make sure he gets a visit from the tooth fairy. // Mr. Crocodile, Daisy and their friends are scared to fetch Martin's gloves from his spooky shed.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.103: The Puzzle of the Plummeting Eggs / The Missing Mole Rat Princess
programme.desc: Sam and Kit look for a mysterious bird who's messing with everyone's nests. // The duo tracks down a royal mole rat who left her underground palace.

programme.title: A Zuma Pira Adventure SSpecial Ep.Special: A Zuma Pira Adventure
programme.desc: Zuma gets tested when Sid wants to destroy Adventure Bay for hidden treasure.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S14 Ep.1401: Pups Stop the Garboni
programme.desc: Farmer Al's new machine, the "Garboni" goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1313: Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin
programme.desc: Mischievous squirrels have made a plan take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S2 Ep.212: Pups Save the Parrot / Pups Save the Queen Bee
programme.desc: The PAW Patrol heads to the jungle to help their friend Carlos find his lost parrot, Mateo! // When the PAW Patrol discovers a beehive in Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse, Ryder and the pups must work together to find the bees a new home.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.126: The Seven Foods / The Perfect Portrait
programme.desc: The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them. // Barbabeau lacks inspiration, he can't create anymore. The whole family helps by suggesting new subjects to paint.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.201: Moving Mission / Barbabright's Invention
programme.desc: During a walk, the Barbapapa family discovers a megalith. // Barbabright has a stroke of genius: the invention of the "BAM".

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.202: Princess For A Day / Barbabeau's Adventure
programme.desc: Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess. // Barbabravo is moping with boredom, his brothers and sisters are all busy and no one wants to play with him.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.103: To The Lighthouse / The Golden Giant
programme.desc: When a storm blows out the lighthouse light, Santi and crew hurry to guide Mami and Abuelo back from sea. // When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.104: The Magic Spyglass / The Stone of Life
programme.desc: Santi and crew are after the legendary Magic Spyglass! But things get tricky when Enrique Real de Palacios III joins the chase. / Santi and crew follow a map to a special treasure, but Bonnie and Sir Butterscotch are hot on their trail.

programme.title: Blue's Clues & You S4 Ep.410: Pearl's Kickball Championship
programme.desc: It's the Neighborhood Kickball Championship! Pearl, the neighborhood's best kicker, has albinism and nystagmus, and so the teams use a Beep Kickball to play. When the ball deflates, Josh plays Blue's Clues to figure out how to save the kickball game!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.803: Lots of Muddy Puddles
programme.desc: Peppa and her family spend the day jumping in different types of puddles, but Peppa thinks one type is still the best puddle in the world!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.830: The Botanical Gardens
programme.desc: Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. There is so much to see and learn and Miss Rabbit and Mr Rabbit are there to tell them all about it.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.831: Mr Potato's Fruit & Vegetable Quiz
programme.desc: Peppa and friends are at school where they have a special guest, Mr Potato! Mr Potato is there to host a special quiz for the children about fruit and vegetables.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.832: Viking Day
programme.desc: Peppa and George join Granny Pig and her friends to play at being Vikings. The Vikings are having fun on Grandpa Pig's boat until they realise they've left their picnic behind!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.833: Made Up Musical Instruments
programme.desc: Today at playgroup Peppa and her friends make their own instruments from bits and bobs of old packaging.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.834: In The Future
programme.desc: Charlotte Sheep is babysitting her cousin Suzy Sheep and her best friend Peppa. Peppa and Suzy are excited at their sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they are all grown up.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.835: Doctor Hamster's Big Present
programme.desc: Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. Dr Hamster wishes she could exercise more, so Grampy Rabbit decides to build something to help...

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.836: Butterflies
programme.desc: Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. The children paint caterpillars, make butterfly wings and even dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.837: Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
programme.desc: It's snowing and Grampy Rabbit has built a jetpack. While showing it to Peppa and George, he shoots off into the distance ending up on top of a snowy mountain. Miss Rabbit goes to rescue him, but Grampy Rabbit is the one that rescues them all.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.838: Detective Potato
programme.desc: Peppa and George are watching Detective Potato on television. When Daddy loses his car in the car park, Detective Potato appears and saves the day!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.839: The Electric Car
programme.desc: Daddy Pig arrives in a new electric car. The family all go for a ride and are surprised when the car talks and sings!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S8 Ep.840: Stone Age Granny
programme.desc: Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

programme.title: DORA S1 Ep.113: Crabby Boots / Papi's Picnic Party
programme.desc: Dora and Boots meet Shelly, a hermit crab missing her shell, who uses one of Boots' boots. Dora travels across the beach in search of her old shell. // Papi is having a quesadilla picnic, but he forgot the ingredients! Dora sets off to deliver them.

programme.title: DORA S3 Ep.308: The Bunny Boyz
programme.desc: Dora and Boots help the Bunny Boyz boy band get super clean and sparkly before their big show!

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S2 Ep.208: Staycation / The Long Shortcut
programme.desc: Daisy arranges a fun "staycation" for Mr. Crocodile at home. // Daisy over-stuffs her closet to clean her room faster, but now can't open it to get the toy she wants.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.125: Barbabravo Is Not Feeling Well / Be Patient Barbabravo...
programme.desc: Following a misadventure, Barbabravo is unable to transform at all. The whole family unites to help him. // Barbabravo can't stay put and is unable to focus one an activity for very long. Barbalala offers to teach him control. Will she succeed?
